mapper.sql: select c.cooperation_id, c.cooperation_no, c.work_id, c.creator_id, c.partner_id, c.contact_id, c.source, c.status, c.expected_amount, c.next_follow_at, c.last_follow_at, c.negotiation_place, c.contact_person, c.contact_value, c.operator_id, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, w.title as work_title, p.partner_name as partner_name, u.nick_name as creator_name from sys_offline_cooperation c left join sys_work w on c.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_partner p on c.partner_id = p.partner_id left join sys_user u on c.creator_id = u.user_id
